text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mayano Top Gun—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Mayano Top Gun was pointing,
I saw a claw machine filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aren't those Paka Puchi plushies?!
They're so super cute~, I want one~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Still, my allowance is in a real pinch, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Mayano Top Gun, whose eyes had been sparkling just a moment ago,
became utterly disheartened."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Then Maya's gonna cheer right next to you!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hooray, hooray, go for it, go for it!
Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
